limitations: This is a spatial proposal only, not construction operations or a rendered review.
The site is held flat at Y=0 despite the stated gentle slope; terrain shaping, retaining, drainage, coastal erosion, flood, and legal setback analysis are not modelled.

Six suites are individually allocated in bounds, but only Suite 01 and Suite 04 have committed exterior threshold anchors. Suites 02, 03, 05, and 06 require their dedicated doors, divided enclosures, and two enclosed stairs in construction before they become accessible constructed spaces.

The grouped wing-shell anchors are envelope commitments, not valid completed interior suite partitions. Bathrooms, dressing rooms, kitchen, service areas, furniture, and all interior fit-out remain deferred.

The water anchor does not create a pool. Construction must add an explicit basin floor, walls, segmented coping, and dry circulation; infinity-edge hydraulics, overflow troughs, filtration, waterproofing, and safety/code verification are unsupported.

The pavilion is the approved fixed curved-pavilion component; its shell and integral furniture are not editable subparts. Freeform terrain, bespoke doubly-curved forms, and automatic roof unions are unsupported.
Property value is treated only as a US$25 million ambition reference; it is not a construction budget, valuation, or floor-area formula.
